items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: But if you know something about George Zack, George liked to drink.

ctx.x: listening to the music. So I had a place to play. And Dan recorded me, and so now I was beginning to get more known. I wasn't living up to those expectations that I was going to tear the town apart, no tearing it apart, but I was getting more known especially with the collectors. As Leonard would say, I'd become the darling of the record collectors.

So eventually, I got a crack at something else. I worked in the Village at the Pirate's Den, as a solo. And about then, Zack came to New York, George Zack. And the boss at the Pirate's Den was very fascinated with him. And he just dreamt about having the two of us. But if you know something about George Zack, George liked to drink. And when he started to drink, nothing else mattered much. He wasn't ugly or vicious or fighting or anything. He just liked to drink and get into sort of a numb feeling.

And so the story that I got was, some boss brought George to New York, and this boss owned a hotel, some sort of hotel. And he said, George, I just want you to play this in big dining room and I'm going to get you dressed up and everything so you'll feel at home. And he sent for the tailor -- got him a room, sent for the tailor, had him measured, got him something to eat, did everything that he should do, and then made one mistake.
